purpose: Finite N-only representations for implementing NEX-1 portable semantics in NEX-1 itself.

inverse: a = v2(n), the number of factors 2 dividing n
pair.note: All derived requirements are total recursive functions over N expressible using fix, succ, pred and ifz.

Bits.canonical_rule: decode as nat-sequence; every element must be 0 or 1

Term.payload_rule: unary payload directly; binary payload via pair(left,right)

Type.payload_rule: TypeVar carries id; Unit/Nat carry 0; binary type formers carry pair(left,right)

Scheme.canonical_rule: bound variable ids are unique, strictly ascending, and scheme normalization may alpha-rename to 0..k-1

Substitution.canonical_rule: type_var_id keys are unique and strictly ascending

TypeEnvironment.payload_rule: nearest binder first; each element is Scheme code

PortableObservation.payload_rule: Nat carries n; Unit/Function carry 0; Pair carries pair(left,right); Inl/Inr carry nested observation

StaticResult.payload_rule: Ok carries normalized Scheme; errors carry stable portable detail code or 0

ToolRequest.payload_rule: payload is Bits or Term code according to request

ToolResult.payload_rule: success carries operation result; failures carry portable error/detail code

canonicality: Every admitted meta-object has exactly one N code under its representation rules.
Tagged values reject tags outside the declared tag set.
Bits rejects sequence elements other than 0 or 1.
Unit/Nat type tags use payload 0 only.
Substitution keys are unique and strictly ascending.
Scheme bound ids are canonicalized before portable comparison.
Malformed meta-encoding is distinct from malformed canonical NEX wire.
Resource refusal is not encoded as semantic invalidity; it remains an execution-control outcome.
